name: Minervamon
main_effect:
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[Opponent's Turn] When your opponent plays a Digimon, you may plays 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost. Any [On Play] effects on Digimon played with this effect don't activate.
[On Deletion] If your opponent has 2 or fewer Digimon in play, you may play 1 purple level 5 or lower Digimon card or 1 [Mervamon] from your trash without paying its memory cost.
